quest.title: Pursuit
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Canotila doesn't seem to be here. Maybe she's in that mysterious place again! Should we start meditating?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Having heard what she said the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a little bit concerned. I'm going to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... This is kinda unsettling, but let's go together!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, why don't you wait out here for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The world in the Book of Revealing...

choices.text: It may be more dangerous than we imagined.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So I don't want you to take the risk.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... we've been journeying together this whole time, haven't we? There's no hardship we can't overcome, and no enemies we can't defeat together.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The dangers inside may not be something force alone can resolve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if you insist! You're smarter than Paimon, so Paimon has faith in you. Just don't abandon Paimon! Paimon will wait right here until you return!

choices.text: Maybe there's a side of it that we don't know about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I promise. I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)

talks.objective: Enter the world of Meditation through the Book of Revealing

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you going to meditate now? Do be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Looks like he can't hear me.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...It's you. I remember you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I was just going to ask you the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Nothing, it's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: #You're {NICKNAME}, right? And... where is the little white thing that's always with you? What was her name again? Why isn't she here?

choices.text: Paimon is waiting for me outside.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Was that her name? Anyway, it doesn't matter. You're a good person, and so is Paimon.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I came here to look for something important. Do you know what it is I'm looking for?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Hmm, never mind. Forget that I asked. Why are you here, anyway? This place is very dangerous... You should turn around now. There were people who once came here for the trial, but they lost their way, and their minds turned to mush.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Huh. I remember now. You and I... We accomplished something incredible together. The only thing in my life that I'm proud of...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: What happened to him? Are you a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo? Or... Are you one of Guillotin's people?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Ah, the golden butterfly. As shiny as the sun itself...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Once you have a light like that, everything will... Everything...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I remember now. Yes, we escaped from the prison under the sea with her — a good thing, too. That was no place for children. She should be living under the sun, amongst the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...Is that so? That makes things easier, then. What's your name?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: #I didn't think I'd see you here, {NICKNAME}. Where's Paimon, though? I don't see her.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Wait, you're not some monster who's transformed into someone I know in order to trick me, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We just saw each other not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...Is that so? It feels like a long time has passed since we said farewell. Might just be my age, though, and my memory getting worse as I get older.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...Are you sure you are not a monster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you still remember?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I remember, yes. Ah. It's really you.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Sorry, I've encountered too many incredible things here, and many battles that could not be won.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: But things have finally changed here. Golden rays of light have arisen, and the sunflowers have bloomed. Even the universe the ancient ones speculated about is not immune to changes.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Maybe things will get better. Maybe I will finally understand, and be able to let go.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Caterpillar...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Come with me.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Haha, I suppose it really is you. I remember now... I knew you, and you haven't changed. You're always sticking your nose in someone else's business, but that's because you're kind and honest.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: But you don't have to worry about me. I don't need help — you've seen what I'm capable of.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: And... Perhaps I know more about this place than even you do.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: #Hilichurl, tell the {M#boy}{F#girl} to leave at once.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you have something to tell me?

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: ...Can you understand what I'm saying? I see. Let me ask you... What am I in your eyes?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A dog.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: Hmm. Maybe there is still hope.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: Leave this place, young one. It's for your own good.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: #I agree, {NICKNAME}. You belong to a brighter world.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have a question...

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: You shouldn't. Goodbye, and don't come back.

choices.text: The apprentice and the little fish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long was I gone for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, just the blink of an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If it was just a blink of an eye to you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing. I suppose it really is dangerous inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, where's Canotila? She didn't go become a guard in the Court of Fontaine, did she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...I'm feeling a little dizzy, let's come back next time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay. Should we find something to eat? Paimon was so worried about you that she's now starving!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wasn't it just a blink of an eye for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it took a lot of effort to worry about you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me get ready first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This isn't where I got to through Meditation before. Over there... That's...)

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I won't just leave like this. Your real name is...
